## Reproduction (pm 2026.11.14)

```console
$ NODE_TEST_CONTEXT=child pm ops telemetry status --json
# enabled=false, env_overrides.test_suppressed=true
$ NODE_TEST_CONTEXT=child PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT=automation pm ops telemetry status --json
# enabled=true, env_overrides.test_suppressed=false
```

## Root cause

`src/core/telemetry/policy.ts`, `resolveTelemetryEnvironmentPolicy`:

```ts
const testSuppressed = inferredTest && !SOURCE_CONTEXTS.has(override) &&
  !telemetryEnvironmentFlag("PM_TELEMETRY_SEND_TEST_EVENTS", env);
```

Every member of `SOURCE_CONTEXTS` (automation, ci, test, ...) counts as an explicit opt-in. Only `test` (or the existing force flag `PM_TELEMETRY_SEND_TEST_EVENTS`) says that test telemetry is intended.

## Impact

- Telemetry and Sentry count package-test fixtures as real automation activity. That is the failure mode the closed inferred-test suppression item fixed, reached by a new route. Expected fixture refusals then look like production errors.
- Emitting children queue events and may start detached flush workers, which slows suites run under agents.

## Fix direction

- When a test runner is detected, suppress unless the opt-in is explicit: `PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT=test` or `PM_TELEMETRY_SEND_TEST_EVENTS`. An inherited `automation`, `ci` or other non-test context no longer re-enables emission.
- `pm ops telemetry status` reports the deciding input, for example `decided_by: "env:NODE_TEST_CONTEXT"` or `"env:PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT"`, next to `test_suppressed`.
- Outside a test runner, `automation` behaves exactly as today.
GH-1735: an inherited PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT=automation re-enables telemetry inside detected test runners, so package test fixtures emit as real automation activity

Inside a detected test runner (NODE_TEST_CONTEXT, VITEST, NODE_ENV=test, BUN_TEST), any recognized PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT re-enables telemetry. resolveTelemetryEnvironmentPolicy suppresses test telemetry only when the override is not a known source context. So an inherited automation value, which agent harnesses and release scripts export to attribute their real writes, makes every pm child a package test suite spawns emit full telemetry labelled automation. The context that labels who acts also decides whether to emit, and no setting keeps both.

With NODE_TEST_CONTEXT set and PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT=automation inherited, telemetry stays suppressed (test_suppressed=true); With PM_TELEMETRY_SOURCE_CONTEXT=test or PM_TELEMETRY_SEND_TEST_EVENTS inside a test runner, telemetry emits labelled test; Outside a test runner, an automation source context behaves exactly as before; pm ops telemetry status reports the deciding input next to test_suppressed
